name: GXO Logistics Distribution Center - West Jefferson OH

fieldNotes.truckGate: Building I sits on an open Park West Drive frontage with a perimeter loop road. z18/z19 satellite and Street View (2024) show no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at any property-line connection, and no perimeter fence around the operational yard. Classed false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No 1-3-vehicle booth at any entrance in z19/z20 satellite or Street View. A small box-shaped structure at the NW edge of the employee parking lot is a utility cabinet/transformer, not a staffed guard booth at a truck lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate, so no remote check-in inference.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Cross-dock building (~712,000 SF, Columbus Logistics Park West Building I) with dock-door banks on both the SW and NE long faces; both faces show trailers backed in. Developer documents 38 docks for the south 343,500 SF portion alone, so the full building exceeds 50 - placed in the 50+ band. Total ~78 estimated; approximate.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock doors run from two physically separate banks on opposite (SW and NE) building faces, so shipping and receiving operate from separate clusters.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Building is recently completed and partly occupied; ~36 trailers parked in the dock courts and drop rows at imagery time, with documented capacity of 85 trailer stalls. Placed in 10-25 visible band; flagged as the building is still ramping up.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide truck courts on both dock faces hold queues well over 3 trucks.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Located in Columbus Logistics Park West, a 232-acre logistics park off I-70 at West Jefferson OH - a small town ~20 miles west of Columbus, surrounded by farmland; per rubric this small-town/edge-of-metro industrial setting resolves to Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property; truck-served only.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide multi-lane access road and large paved dock courts give ample room to add an express/bypass lane.

citations.claim: GXO West Jefferson OH site (202 Park West Dr) will cease operations, 100+ workers affected; WARN filed Mar 3 2026, effective May 2 2026

verification.rationale: GXO is closing the West Jefferson (202 Park West Dr) site; WARN filed Mar 2026, closure effective May 2026.
verification.reason: GXO announced closure (WARN Mar 3 2026, effective May 2 2026).
